sentences.text: Edward P. Decker serves as Chair, and as President and Chief Executive Officer of The Home Depot Inc.
He took on the role in October 2022, giving him a tenure of approximately 3.96 years in the position.
The combined chair and chief executive responsibilities place leadership of the board and day-to-day management of the company in his hands.

sentences.text: Decker, a Home Depot veteran since 2000 who rose through merchandising and the president and COO role, became CEO and president in March 2022, and the board elected him chairman effective October 2022, combining the two roles.
Management has pursued a consistent strategy of store investment, interconnected retail and Pro capabilities, with 3.7 billion dollars of fiscal 2025 capital expenditures.

Stated capital allocation priorities are reinvestment first, then the dividend, then buybacks; 9.2 billion dollars was returned in dividends in fiscal 2025 after a 2.2 percent increase, while repurchases remained paused following the SRS acquisition.
Reported five-year total shareholder return was 56.3 percent.
